solid_body = p.part

with BuildPart() as seat_p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk2:
        with BuildLine() as bl2:
            s1 = Line((0, shaft_length), (tip_diameter/2, shaft_length))
            s2 = Line(s1@1, (0, shaft_length - seat_depth))
            s3 = Line(s2@1, (0, shaft_length))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

solid_body = solid_body - seat_p.part

pocket_box = Pos(pocket_offset, shaft_length/2, 0) * Box(pocket_width, pocket_depth, shaft_diameter)
solid_body = solid_body - pocket_box

hole_cyl = Pos(pocket_offset, shaft_length/2, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(pocket_width/4, shaft_diameter)
solid_body = solid_body - hole_cyl

tip_edges = solid_body.edges().sort_by(Axis.Y)[-1:]
solid_body = chamfer(tip_edges, chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "shaft_with_pocket"
export_step(part, "output.step")
